description: This file contains custom autograd Function classes for synchronized batch normalization, cross-map local response normalization, and a backward hook, used in deep learning models with distributed training.

classes.name: SyncBatchNorm
classes.description: Custom autograd Function for synchronized batch normalization across distributed processes.

classes.name: CrossMapLRN2d
classes.description: Custom autograd Function implementing cross-map local response normalization.

classes.name: BackwardHookFunction
classes.description: Custom autograd Function for a non-differentiable backward hook.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs forward pass for SyncBatchNorm or CrossMapLRN2d, applying normalization.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Performs backward pass for SyncBatchNorm or CrossMapLRN2d, computing gradients.
